core_obligations: The easy direction (proof lines 5078-5079): if f is at-worst-nodal of relative dimension 1, then each base change X x_S U_i -> U_i is at-worst-nodal of relative dimension 1 by the base change lemma.

Descent of the structure (lines 5081-5087): for the converse, being locally of finite presentation, flat, and of relative dimension 1 are each fpqc local on the target (cited descent/morphisms lemmas); taking fibres reduces the question to the case where S is the spectrum of a field.

The field case (lines 5090-5093): over a field the result follows from lemma-node-field-extension and the fpqc-locality of smoothness on the target; hence (2) implies (1) and the property is fpqc local on the target.
proof_roadmap: Descend the structural properties along the fpqc covering to reduce to a field.
Conclude with the field-case node criterion and smoothness locality.
